Super Massive Black Hole

N-Body physics simulates a Black Hole Accretion Disk. Spheres are initialized in a stable orbit, but inelastic collisions and tidal friction grind away their orbital energy, causing them to spiral inward into the Event Horizon.

Click and drag to rotate the camera around the Black Hole. Scroll to zoom.
